name: Home: The Story of Earth
summary: In 1969, the first humans to travel to the moon looked back at the whole of the Earth. Since then our understanding of our planetary home and our impact upon it has grown exponentially.

name: Getting Together
summary: A pair of pop-oriented songwriters -- melodist/singer Bobby and tone-deaf lyricist Lionel -- try to eke out a living in the Los Angeles music scene. They live (along with Bobby's younger sister Jennifer) in an antique shop, and Bobby works on the side as a recording engineer until he and Lionel get their big break.

name: The Guardians
summary: In a near-future Britain, the far-right government has declared a state of emergency and suspended elections. The Queen has fled in protest, while the defence of the state is in the hands of the Guardians, a paramilitary force with absolute power and a ruthless determination to stamp out resistance.

name: The Julie Andrews Hour
summary: Julie Andrews presents an hour of variety.

name: O'Hara, U.S. Treasury
summary: James O'Hara of the United States Treasury works in several branches to stop illegal activities such as smuggling contraband, tax evasion, and the like.

name: Madigan
summary: Dan Madigan is a veteran police officer in New York, now dedicated to investigating cases in Europe. He is incorruptible and organized crime is the target.

name: J'Irai Dormir Chez Vous
summary: Antoine de Maximy goes on his own to different countries around the world and tries to get invited to spend the night at local people's homes to learn more about their way of life and the customs of the place.

name: Asphalt-Cowboys - Ladies on Tour
summary: Asphalt Cowboys - Ladies on Tour focuses on four women who are very familiar with large vehicles such as trucks, heavy transporters or trailers. Moni, Christina, Anne and Janet are on the road in Germany and Europe and make sure that the goods they are transporting find their way to the customers. It doesn't matter that they don't conform to the stereotype of a truck driver, because everyone is the same behind the wheel. The four ladies face their challenges with a mixture of ambition, zest for action and stamina - every day anew.

name: J'irai dormir chez vous L'intégrale
summary: From his kitchen, Antoine de Maximy goes behind the scenes of his travels. Between anecdotes and filming secrets, Antoine will tell the highlights.

name: The Car Club
summary: Bruce, Mark and Amelia meet car enthusiasts sharing their passion of cars from old to new, and everything in between.

name: The Texas Wheelers
summary: Comedy about the four motherless Wheeler children and their lovable but cantankerous father Zack. With Zack avoiding work, Truckie led the clan, with Doobie, Boo, and T.J.

name: Doctors' Hospital
summary: Life in the neurological wing of Lowell Memorial Hospital as seen through the eyes of Jake Goodwin, the chief neurosurgeon.

name: Hot l Baltimore
summary: The lives and loves of residents of a seedy Baltimore hotel, adapted from an off-Broadway play The Hot l Baltimore by Lanford Wilson.

name: Midnight Horror: Six Nights
summary: An omnibus work composed of six episodes depicting the horrors found in everyday life. When an ordinary daily life turns into horror, it becomes eerie.

previousepisode.name: The Beauty with the Hidden Blade

name: Кухня по любви
summary: Chef Alexander Belkovich and his wife Olga will teach you how to cook delicious and simple dishes with great love and for the whole family.

name: This Young Hero Is a Little Cold
summary: Teenage game player Lu Lu inadvertently enters a game, becoming the villain Yin Er San. She then has to fully upgrade to complete the task of overcoming the demons while she explores the male protagonist's romantic feelings.

name: Lost Worlds with Ben Fogle
summary: Ben Fogle travels to a trio of locations around the world to explores de-industrialisation and to uncover their stories.

previousepisode.name: A Grande e Ardente Terra de Alentejo-de Algarve e Sol, Pão Seco e Pão Mole

name: Дедлайн
summary: A documentary project with a rejuvenating effect. Every year in Russia more and more people prove their purpose, that at 60 everything is just beginning. They are happy to break the stereotypes about old age that have taken root in society and enjoy every day. The heroes of "Deadline" change their lifestyle without fear, find new vocations in the modeling business, act in films, become content makers, build new relationships and live so brightly and actively that even those who are commonly called "young" will envy them. After all, age is not an obstacle to the realization of a dream.

name: La Pitchoune: Cooking in France
summary: Makenna Held bought Julia Child's home in France and turned it into a recipe-free cooking school. Now, she and her team welcome students into this iconic kitchen where enthusiasts learn to step out of their comfort zone and tap into their intuition.

name: The Challenge Australia
summary:
Hosted by Brihony Dawson and filmed in Buenos Aires, Argentina, The Challenge Australia will see an algorithm randomly pair challengers to compete in gruelling physical contests, test strategies, survive eliminations, cutthroat alliances and steamy hook-ups to win daily challenges and eliminate their opponents.

The final male and female challengers will be declared Challenge champions by the end of the season, winning $100,000 each in prize money and their entry into the first ever The Challenge: Global Championship, where they will represent Australia in hopes to be the first ever Challenge World Champion.

With old rivalries, new alliances, messy exes, and fractured friendships to navigate, who has what it takes to go down in reality television history, as Australia's first Challenge Champion?

name: Medical Story
summary: The producers of Police Story investigate the medical realm, displaying strong diagnostics.

name: Zombie Dumb
summary: The zombie epidemic, which all of us are so scared on TV, yet occurred. Gradually people did not become. Zombies have gone to live in a dungeon, where there is no sunlight - there they are better. Over time, they remembered that they were once human beings. They built schools and began to develop. Zombiwill is an ordinary town, like many in a dungeon. There lives a lot of kids who do not sit still. Their favorite occupation is to play things that once belonged to people.

name: Seven Wonders
summary: Seven Wonders centers on Dr. Nate Grady, a brilliant botanist-adventurer who teams up with the slippery international fixer Sloane Seydoux on a breathless race to solve an ancient mystery tied to the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

name: The Root
summary:
Roisaithong is an orphan girl who was adopted by Rungrorng's father, and upon his father's death was looked after by him.

When Roisaithong discovered that Rungrorng viewed her in a romantic way and not as a sister, she begins to attempt to run away. However... this task seems to be quite difficult since Rungrorng is always around her and watching her.

This drama is about a young girl's journey of escaping her benefactor who is sexually perverted and has caused her a lot of trauma. Will Roisaithong be able to change her life?

Adapted from the novel of the same name by author Khun Kritsana Asokesin (กฤษณา อโศกสิน).

name: Mr. Midnight: Beware the Monsters
summary: A young teenager, Tyar starts to experience supernatural apparitions. Initially treating the strange events as a means to develop their online 'ghost hunting' persona, Mr. Midnight, the group find themselves in increasingly perilous situations. At the same time, Tyar begins to unravel a family secret that may just lead to the key that will not only save them, but their home as well. As the situation escalates, Tyar's four friends, Ling, Nat, Zoe and Ben also face their own personal demons. As Tyar's visions become more real, his friends are drawn into a cat and mouse game with a malevolent spirit.

name: The Travelling Auctioneers
summary:
The Travelling Auctioneers sees Christina, JJ, Robin and Izzie split off into pairs and take their travelling auction house and workshop out on the road across the UK. Along the way, they'll unearth hidden gems and turn unwanted items into winning lots.

Sifting through one family home at a time, the team will first need to identify the items with the biggest selling appeal. Christina and Izzie will then call on their auctioneer contacts and expertise, whilst JJ and Robin use their incredible craft and restoration skills to bring new life to neglected treasures – ready for a thrilling on-site auction at the end of each episode.

name: Scotland's Biggest Families
summary: A look inside two of Scotland's biggest families.

name: Together Stronger
summary: Documentary telling the inside story of the revolution that transformed Wales from a team lower than Haiti in the world rankings to World Cup heroes.

name: Beechgrove Gardens in Winter
summary: A special series to help guide you through everything you need to tackle as the days grow shorter and the temperatures drop.

name: La vita bugiarda degli adulti
summary: Young Giovanna navigates her passage from childhood into adolescence as she experiences the different sides of Naples during the 1990s.

name: Beach Cottage Chronicles
summary: Discover the inspired designs, architecture and stories behind some of the most beautiful waterfront cottages in America. With each unique home, experience a firsthand look at the joy that comes from living on the water.

name: Пробный переезд
summary: Anfisa Chernykh and Anton Zaitsev set out on a journey across the country to find out where in Rus' to live well and happily. The hosts will explore the country and tell you amazing things about cities worth moving to. Where and for how much to rent a house? Where to get a job? Which restaurant to choose? No hackneyed advice from guidebooks, only answers to the most vital questions.

name: Pepsi, Where's My Jet?
summary: The year was 1996, and the cola wars were raging. Despite Pepsi's celeb-soaked advertisements, Coke still held the bigger market share, so the second-place brand decided to roll out their biggest campaign ever: Called "Pepsi Stuff," it featured a soon-to-be infamous commercial implying that if you just bought enough of their products, you could use "Pepsi Points" to purchase sunglasses, leather jackets… and maybe a Harrier jet? Pepsi execs assumed the astronomical "price" of the military plane was set high enough to indicate it was a joke, but college student John Leonard saw it as a challenge, and decided to call their bluff. Enlisting the help (and funding) of mountaineering buddy Todd Hoffman, Leonard hashed out a plan to score the grandest prize of all – even if it never existed in the first place. Shot in a rollicking, irreverent style and soaked in the music and culture of the mid-'90s, Pepsi, Where's My Jet? sits down with Leonard, Hoffman, the commercial's creative team, and a truly unexpected cast of tangentially-involved public figures to tell the legendary tale of the kid who sued Pepsi for a fighter jet, and became the hero of a new generation.

name: Fight Song
summary: Hanae, having just had her dreams of continuing karate dashed, meets Haruki, the writer of her pre-match song. This woman who has dedicated her life to karate, with no time for love, is now face-to-face with a man who fears he can't write good music because he's incapable of understanding the human heart. Now at a turning point in their lives, the pair begin a fake relationship in an attempt to understand true love. However, Hanae's enamored childhood friend Shingo gets involved, and a love triangle is formed. But she's got a secret, one that made her decide that this would be her final romance. Awkward yet candid, what will come of this heroine's first and last romantic adventure?! This humanistic rom-com with irritating sad love and growth.

name: Steel Troops
summary: It is a military survival program in which reservists from the elite special forces form a team and fight for the honor of each unit.

name: Autumn in My Heart
summary: Accidently swapped at birth, Pichaa and Pan go on to lead very different lives: Pichaa grows up with loving parents and a brother, Patin, while Pan is raised by a single parent in poverty. One fateful day, the two are returned to their biological families. Drama ensues when over a decade later, Pichaa is reunited with Patin, whom she once believed to be her brother. Things are further complicated when they fall for one another romantically.

name: Lulu
summary: Two women's paths cross when they are both in the middle of their personal crossroads. Will they find love when they need it the least?

name: My Roommate
summary: 6 people live together in Xian's apartment, and romantic feelings begin to grow under the eaves...

name: The Parent Test
summary: Based on a hit Australian television format, The Parent Test will explore the many distinctively different parenting styles. From helicopter to child-led parents, 12 families are put under the microscope in the ultimate parenting stress test and will share learnings about emotional hot-button topics that compare the multiple styles of parenting. The families are put through various situations to foster conversations about how each unit operates. Host Ali Wentworth and parenting expert Dr. Adolph Brown moderate these impassioned conversations amongst parents who may have conflicting opinions on how to raise their families, but they all share the common goal of raising happy, healthy children.

name: Love & Hip Hop: Where Are They Now?
summary: Fan-favorite cast members from the powerhouse Love & Hip Hop franchise reminisce and relive the biggest moments from the series by hitting rewind over the last 10 years. From breakups, shocking betrayals, and most buzzed about moments, viewers get to hear the juicy background story straight from the cast members through exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes intel, while getting the latest updates on their successes today and surprising revelations of where life has taken our former cast members since we last saw them.

name: Black Widows: Kiss, Marry, Kill
summary: Black Widows: Kiss, Marry, Kill is a one-hour docuseries that chronicles the stories of deceitful women who marry men for the wrong reasons -- ending in murder.

name: Captains
summary: The qualifiers for the 2022 FIFA World Cup are in full swing. Captain Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang prepares his golden generation Gabon team in a massive match against Mo Salah's Egypt. Injury gives Croatia captain and Ballon D'or winner Luka Modric the chance to reflect where it all began. Jamaica captain Andre Blake must unite a team of players, all with big ideas and bigger egos.

name: Inseparables: Amor al límite
summary: The love between 13 famous couples will be put to the test in a competition full of challenges for the body and the mind, with which it will be evident how much trust exists between them. With ambitious bets, the participants will discover that betting on love is a great investment.

previousepisode.name: Un gran final, lleno de sorpresas

name: Anna German
summary: A dramatized biography of Anna German: a Polish singer, immensely popular in Poland and in the Soviet Union in the 1960s-1970s.

name: Food Truck Face Off
summary: For food truck owners, Eddie Jackson's Rosehill Beer Garden is the hottest spot in Houston. Each weekend, three new food trucks compete for a chance to face off against the resident Rosehill food trucks to win a permanent spot. It takes fast ticket times, great personalities and showstopping food to impress Eddie, but the worst performing truck has to pull up stakes and head out of Rosehill for good.

previousepisode.name: A Fight for Redemption at Rosehill

name: Wildest New Zealand
summary: New Zealand's islands are home to an odd assortment of curious creatures that scoff at nature's norms. Birds can't fly, parrots play in snowy mountain meadows, and penguins roam the streets in these topsy-turvy habitats.

name: Priere De Ne Pas Envoyer Des Fleurs
summary: Patrice L'Ecuyer est à la barre de Prière de ne pas envoyer de fleurs, une émission de variétés exceptionnelle. Chaque semaine, un artiste que vous aimez y perdra la vie, devant vos yeux, dans une fiction humoristique, par exemple en étant avalé par un monstre marin. Ensuite, nous célébrerons son passage sur terre à travers de vibrants, et parfois même de cinglants témoignages de ses proches, qui rappelleront de façon inusitée les moments de sa vie qui méritent d'être soulignés. Cette émission de variétés, un concept original, se traduira par une grande célébration de la vie et de la carrière d'artistes aimés du public québécois. Prière de ne pas envoyer de fleurs, mais peut-être d'en lancer... avec ou sans le pot!

name: Storybots: Answer Time
summary: Got a question? The StoryBots have an answer! Join curious friends Beep, Boop, Bing, Bang and Bo on fun adventures to find facts for real kids like you.

name: Horsepower
summary: Follows top UK trainer Andrew Balding and his stables at Kingsclere. Offering a behind-the-scenes look into the yard's fortunes (and misfortunes) as they search for the next equine superstar. Preparing runners for owners such as The Queen and the ruling family of Qatar, targeting world famous events such as the Breeders' Cup, Epsom Derby and Royal Ascot.

name: The Good Ship Murder
summary:
The Good Ship Murder is set aboard a luxury cruise liner touring everyone's favorite Mediterranean holiday hotspots bubbling with intrigue, rivalries, glamour, money and class divides – but its new cabaret singer, ex detective Jack Grayling, soon discovers there are also more sinister elements below the surface. 

On a cruise out of Southampton, Jack meets newly promoted First Officer, Kate Woods. Fierce and ambitious, she's a woman in a man's world with plenty to prove. After a passenger is found murdered in their first port of call, Kate's dream of her own command is thrown into Jeopardy and Jack finds himself thrust back into his former life as a detective. What follows is a wave of murder mysteries – each set against the backdrop of a different stunning coastal destination where the ship has dropped anchor.

name: World's Greatest Train Journeys from Above
summary: This series follows some of the world's most extraordinary railway journeys from above and on the ground, taking the audience on an adventure of a lifetime.

name: Inside the Sydney Opera House
summary: For the first time in its history, the Sydney Opera House has allowed cameras to go behind the scenes to reveal what it takes to run one of the world's busiest and most iconic performing arts centres.

previousepisode.name: It'll be Alright on the Night

name: Art is a State of Mind
summary: The documentary series follows Bernhard Zünkeler over nine years as he set up his own art labs and artist collectives and established a global network of like-minded people between Los Angeles, Havana and Berlin.

name: Till the World Ends
summary: Till the World Ends is a story of two young men as they find themselves accidentally living together throughout the last 13 days of the world. Art a very attractive business student; unfortunately an accident caused him to lose his memories. Due to that, Art relies on Golf to help him navigate and prepare for the end of the world. Golf, a medical student, has a stressful history of family and relationship problems. Gus, his only brother also in jail, he has no one left. At the time Art has an accident, the government announces the evacuation of people to the bunker because the world will end soon. Golf, who was involved in the incident decided not to go to the bunker but to help Art instead. The rest of their lives outside were full of chaos. They both being chased by Long and Joke who had purpose to kill people as many as he can before the world ends. Golf has never felt what is a deep love from another person. He wanted nothing more, just to find love while he still has chance before he dies, Art wanted to go back to his hometown. Their relationship was improved and they seemed to know that they both are "in love". Golf and Art need to navigate their confusing feelings for each other. Because they both know exactly that they are going to die.

name: Los Sobrevivientes: Colonia Dignidad
summary: Colonia Dignidad ('Dignity Colony') was a unique case in the world. It was a sect and an evil empire based upon sexual abuse and exploitation.

name: Glow Up - Deutschlands nächster Make-up-Star
summary: Riccardo Simonetti accompanies ten talents on their way to becoming Germany's next make-up star, rated by Armin Morbach and Loni Baur, among others.

name: Tug of Words
summary: Tug of Words, hosted by Samantha Harris. A wordplay game show from the team behind Who Wants to Be a Millionaire. Two teams compete to answer word-clue questions correctly and pull the flag on the "tug of war rope" to their side. In Round 1, each answer involves changing a single letter in the word that appears on the board.

name: Súbete a mi Moto
summary: In 1979, in Caguas, Puerto Rico, at the initiative of an ambitious and skilled businessman named Edgardo Díaz, a group was born that laid the foundations for the "boy bands" that still exist today. Creating never-before-seen rules and a work style that had never been implemented before, he developed a group that continues to be the benchmark for all other Hispanic youth bands.

name: La Novia Gitana
summary: Elena Blanco, veteran homicide inspector of the BAC (Case Analysis Brigade), is an intelligent woman obsessed with work, tormented by a dark event from her past. She tries to scare away her ghosts with alcohol, sex and music, while she searches for the culprit in the murder of Susana Macaya, a young gypsy girl who disappeared after her bachelorette party and with whom someone has performed a macabre ritual that reproduces the death of her sister seven years earlier. The great unknown is that Lara's murderer has been serving time since then, so either he has a copycat... or there is an innocent man in jail.

name: Mind Your Manners
summary: Have you ever wondered how to elegantly cut… a banana? Mind Your Manners follows world-renowned etiquette teacher Sara Jane Ho as she helps her students become their best selves and put others at ease, using the language of manners and etiquette. Get ready to laugh, cry, and learn a thing or two as Sara transforms her students' lives and helps them acquire the confidence to shine in any situation - starting with a sensible spot of afternoon tea. Pinkies in or out?

name: Junji Ito Maniac: Japanese Tales of the Macabre
summary: Compilation of 20 Junji Ito's famous horror stories.

name: Itoshi no Nina
summary: One day, Atsushi was suddenly told by his close friend Masa that Aota Niina has been abducted. Aota Niina is a female student from Seiryu Gakuen, and is someone whom Masa fell in love with at first sight. Atsushi went to Masa's apartment and found Niina being tied up. After hearing that the school's number one delinquent Ushijima would be arriving, Atsuhi quickly escaped the apartment with Niina. After that incident, Atsushi told Niina that the culprit was Ushijima, not Masa. However, due to trauma, Niina could not sleep at night and told Atsushi to take responsibility by becoming her bodyguard.

previousepisode.name: The Beginning and The End of Our Love

name: Notre Europe, quelle histoire !
summary: From Greek Antiquity to the EU of 28, ten episodes to review the major stages of European history and celebrate the 60th anniversary of the Treaty of Rome. First part: the story begins with a founding Greek myth, that of the union between Zeus and the young princess Europe.

name: Умка
summary: White bear cub Umka with his mother Bear lives in the harsh and beautiful Arctic. He has wonderful friends – the mischievous wolf Ilma, the cute seal Bark and the funny pink seagull Pychik. And Umka's most important friend is the Chukchi boy Taike. The boy and the animals explore the wonderful world of the North together and learn to respect nature and each other. Stories about Umka and his friends are told on behalf of an adult Thai who grew up and became a Shaman. His fairy tales are imbued with the spirit of the Arctic and its legends – kind, instructive and wise.

name: World War II: Secrets from Above
summary: As we fly above the infamous battle sites of D-Day and Dunkirk, soar over hidden Nazi bunkers, and glide across lost battleships and sunken shipwrecks – this new series exposes secrets of World War Two - in a brand-new way.

name: The 1619 Project
summary: The 1619 Project seeks to reframe the country's history by placing the consequences of slavery and the contributions of Black Americans at the very center of the national narrative.

name: Это миниатюры
summary: The show "This is Miniatures" will bring together duets and trios that work in this genre. Within each episode, several participants will show numbers, and an auditorium of 100 people will put "likes" or "dislikes". The more votes "for" the comedians get, the greater their chances of winning the final prize - 200 thousand rubles. However, in the battle for victory, you need to defeat not only the declared rivals, but also the guest stars who will perform at the end of each issue.

name: Cross
summary: Based on NY Times Bestselling author James Patterson's #1 hero, Cross is a crime thriller that follows the investigations of brilliant forensic psychologist and DC Metro Detective Alex Cross. Together with his best friend and partner Detective John Sampson, Cross delves into the psyches of America's most insidious killers while fighting to protect his family from the dangers of the criminal world.

name: Black Rabbit
summary: Set against the backdrop of New York City's high-pressure nightlife scene, Black Rabbit centers on two brothers who are pushed to the brink by their duty to family and their pursuit of success. Jake Friedken is the charismatic owner of Black Rabbit, a restaurant and VIP lounge, poised to become the hottest spot in New York. But when his brother, Vince, returns to the business unexpectedly, trouble soon follows; opening the door to old traumas and new dangers that threaten to bring down everything they've built. Black Rabbit is a propulsive thrill ride and character examination about the way an unbreakable bond between two brothers can shatter their world and everything in its orbit.

name: Roadworthy Rescues
summary: Thousands of great American cars are slowly rotting away in hidden places across the country. Most of these vehicles are long forgotten relics that are destined never to drive down another road. Derek Bieri of the popular Vice Grip Garage YouTube channel wants to change that. He has a deep seeded belief that all these vehicles should get a second chance. Follow Derek as he seeks out abandoned cars from America's past and gets them running and back on the road where they belong.

name: The Bends
summary: The Bends follows a seemingly perfect American family in Berlin whose secrets come to light when they hire a new nanny, unaware that she is trying to expose the parents' corrupt financial and familial ties.

name: Vale Tudo com Tim Maia
summary: With unpublished images, shows and rare interviews, the series bets on the irreverent way of the "síndico" of Brazilian music to narrate his own trajectory.

name: Al Wasem
summary: After being betrayed, Nawras and Ragheed embark on a perilous mission to obtain important papers that may grant them control over a global mafia and its trade.

name: Ride of Your Life with Courtney Hansen
summary: Courtney Hansen leads an all-star team of the baddest custom car builders in the country, coming together each day to work on custom beauties to help make the lives of individuals who've faced tragedies and setbacks just a little bit better.

name: Сердце Ивлеевой
summary: A grandiose romantic experiment: the main bachelorette of the country is looking for a new love! No gigolos, hype guys, pumped eggplant jocks and mother's rappers - only real and sincere men in the fight for Nastya's heart.

name: Blood, Sex & Royalty
summary: A modern take on the British royal drama, this steamy series offers a window into the lives of history's deadliest, sexiest and most iconic monarchs.

name: El inmortal
summary: During the 90s, cocaine trafficking and control of Madrid's nightclubs was in the hands of a gang that monopolized hundreds of covers and television programs: Los Miami. His name caused the panic of those who heard him. "The Immortal" was the head of all of them.

name: Shards of Her
summary: Waking up from a coma, an accomplished headhunter finds herself in an alternate reality where she has to revisit an excruciating childhood trauma.

name: As Gentle as You
summary: A sudden car accident turned fan Song Yu Fei into the secret wife of entertainment industry actor Qin Jing Xiao. As they learn to get along, their first impression of each other changes, and soon sparks of love appear between them.

name: Almost Lover
summary:
During their studies, He Xiaozhan, Xiao Shangqi and Chen Fei'er were close friends. He Xiaozhan had loved Xiao Shangqi for eight years, but kept quiet about it because the young man was infatuated with Chen Fei'er. The incident on the eve of graduation destroyed the friendship between the inseparable trio. Faced with the double betrayal of love and friendship, He Xiaozhan moves from Shanghai to another city and becomes the host of a late-night radio show.
Three years later, Xiao Shangqi arrives in the same city to become the manager of a four-star hotel that is on the verge of closing. Former friends reunite, and through misunderstandings, misunderstandings and difficulties, they finally get to know each other and come to love.

name: The Wingfeather Saga
summary: In a fantasy world of wonder and danger, one boy discovers a family secret that may awaken an ancient power or doom them to capture by a nameless evil.

name: Designated Love
summary: Qin Xi is an art director who puts love first, but is independent and has a high IQ. One evening she accidentally saw that her boyfriend's childhood friend was going to kiss him. Four years of accumulated disappointment forced her to resign immediately and part without delay. At the same time, the phone was bursting with spam, in which the game "Play an ex-boyfriend" was being promoted. The enraged Qin Xi didn't hesitate to open a fantasy game to unlock a love strategy with a two-faced guy.

name: Fall in Love in the Book
summary: The author of poorly-selling novels, Jiang Gogo, after an accident falls into a popular love novel as an evil minor character. There she meets the main villain Gu Yanliang and falls in love with him. But, like any negative character, the villain also has his secrets. Will they interfere with happiness?

name: My Dearest Boss
summary:
Yu Xing Chui's life has always been filled with misfortunes, but her fate begins to change from this moment!
One day she was working overtime at a company when she unexpectedly received a mysterious phone call that she was suddenly inheriting her aunt's estate.
On the first night of her stay at the mansion, Yu Xing Chui was so excited that she mistakenly entered the wrong door and got into the house of her new neighbor, who turned out to be her boss Liu Yuan An.

name: She Makes My Heart Flutter
summary: A queer web drama that depicts different women who have something in common.

name: La última
summary: Candela, a young woman who works in a logistics company while pursuing her dream of becoming a singer. Her life changes one night when an international record company executive listens to her singing in a bar. That same night, Candela reunites with Diego, a high-school classmate who is struggling to become a professional boxer.

name: Chicken Girls: Forever Team
summary: The Chicken Girls come together over their shared love of LEGO.

name: Great Lakes Untamed
summary: The Great Lakes, home to a fifth of the world's fresh water and the backbone of a vast ecosystem, are explored from every angle on this documentary series.

name: Circuit Breakers
summary: Circuit Breakers is a half-hour thought-provoking futuristic anthology series about middle-schoolers in the near future that uses science fiction as a backdrop to tell universal stories about growing up. But not everything is as it seems, and their curiosity leads to chaos. Each installment of Circuit Breakers features a sci-fi twist on kid relatable stories, with the intent of kids and families asking themselves how they would act in each unique situation.

name: Charles: Our New King
summary: A two-part documentary which shines a light on the new British monarch, told with an extensive collection of rare royal archive and revelatory interviews from those who know him.

name: Colin From Accounts
summary: Centred on Ashley and Gordon, two single(ish), complex humans who are brought together by a car accident and an injured dog, Colin From Accounts is about flawed, funny people choosing each other and being brave enough to show their true self, scars and all, as they navigate life together.

name: Santa Claus: The Serial Killer
summary: Award-winning journalist Mobeen Azhar investigates the story behind the murders of eight men in Toronto, Canada.

name: Erynie
summary: Lviv, May 1939. A little boy dies in terrible torments. The news of the ritual murder committed by Jews is circulating around the city. Panic breaks out. Whose baby will be next? The whole city counts on commissioner Edward Popielski. However, the commissioner does not want to pursue the case. Not this time. The specter of the impending war and paralyzing fear rule Lviv, only its criminal world still lives according to the old rules. Everyone knows Popielski, who works only at night. Nobody wants to work with him. Nobody wants to expose themselves to him. The city steeped in crime has obscured the shadow of Erinia, the goddesses of vengeance.

name: Reinlykke
summary: In the heart of Sami land lies Kautokeino. The Eira family lives here. They own one of the largest reindeer herds in Finnmarksvidda. For generations, the reindeer have provided them with a livelihood. They have pure luck.

name: Yürek Çıkmazı
summary: Cennet, who has been abused by her husband for years, gets sick and is hospitalized. While her treatment continues, she sees Lawyer Zeynep's number on the window of the hospital and calls for help. Cennet gives her a letter to open after she dies. This letter brings Cennet's eldest son Halil and Zeynep together, but it also causes a conflict between the brothers. Although Halil and Zeynep come together for Cennet, a romance begins between them.

name: A Familiar Stranger
summary: Shi Qi is a talented and good-natured artist who, during one of her painting assignments, learns of an affair between the chancellor's cruel and exploitative daughter, Shen Qin, and the ruler of the realm, King Ning. Shen Qin, however, is engaged to marry the powerful general Xiao Han Sheng. But when Shi Qi accidentally witnesses deadly and nefarious goings-on at the court, she finds herself drawn into trouble. Shen Qin devises a way to enlist a magician to swap her face with that of Shi Qi – so that she and the painter can "switch" identities. As such, Shi Qi ends up "engaged" to Xiao Han Sheng, while Shen Qin takes up the painter's identity. But the "real" Shi Qi has already crossed paths with Xiao Han Sheng many years ago – even though he has no idea who she truly "is" now.

name: Lanigan's Rabbi
summary: Irish Police Chief Paul Lanigan and his best friend Rabbi David Small solve crimes in the small town of Cameron, California.

previousepisode.name: In Hot Weather, The Crime Rate Soars

name: Mr. T and Tina
summary: A Japanese inventor moves his family from Tokyo, Japan to Chicago, Illinois where he hires a scatterbrained and free spirited American woman to be the live in governess for his two children.

name: Rafferty
summary: Ex-military surgeon Dr. Sidney Rafferty has just retired as a colonel after 23 years in the army and has now brought his rigid army ways and short temper to the more casual environment at City General Hospital.

previousepisode.name: Death Out of a Blue Sky

name: A Year at the Top
summary: Two wide-eyed and struggling songwriters leave their home in Boise, Idaho and head for Hollywood for their "big break". There they make a deal with the devil's son, Frederick J. Hanover – who heads up Paragon Records – to have a year of success.

name: Since I Met U
summary: Chen Mu is a dessert store manager. Rich Jiang Xi Han is a culinary blogger. Thanks to the delicious desserts and the cute baby Rui Rui, they accidentally became a happy family of three.

name: The Little Wife of the General
summary: Su Qian is a chef at a restaurant with three Michelin stars. Escaping from another blind date arranged by her caring mother, the girl gets hit by a car and is transported to the past. Now she has only three months to find her love, otherwise she will never come home. But, fortunately, the next day Su Qian is married off to a domineering handsome general, only he doesn't even want to see her. Maybe unique cooking skills will pave the way for the girl to the heart of an unapproachable general?

name: In the Beginning
summary: The series featured the relationship between stuffed-shirt, conservative priest Father Cleary and liberal, streetwise nun Sister Agnes (known as "Aggie") that run a ghetto mission together in Baltimore. While Aggie was from the area and enjoyed the assignment, Father Cleary had difficulty dealing with her (frequently referring to her as "Attila the Nun"), as well as the neighborhood prostitutes, hustlers and winos.

name: Idol in My Living Room
summary: A youth melodrama that unfolds when Joy, an excellent student at Sejong Institute, and Yeo-won, a Hallyu Wave idol star, accidentally live in one house.

name: The Losers
summary: Sydney Foskett is a wrestling promoter who discovers young new wrestler and part-time footballer, "The Butcher", whose real name is Nigel. Foskett, realising that the public love a loser, devises ways for "The Butcher" to lose without the dimwitted Nigel to know what is happening. Foskett often gets paid well for rigging the matches.

name: Screengrabbed Too: BBC Introducing Arts
summary: Huw Stephens presents an exciting selection of short films from emerging artists and film-makers from across the UK. Topics are fresh, varied and thought-provoking, including a behind-the-scenes look at a zoo closing for the night, an honest account of farming the land, and a powerful love letter from a son to a mother who has cancer. Expect to be moved and challenged by these short dramas, observations and dance, made by a new generation of storytellers.

name: A New Kind of Family
summary: Kit Flanagan, a widowed mother of three shares a home with a divorced woman, Abby Stone, and her daughter Jill in an effort to save money.

name: Who's Watching the Kids?
summary: The story of two showgirls Stacy and Angie at the seedy "Club Sand Pile" in Las Vegas. The girls share an apartment with Frankie, Angie's 15-yr-old brother and Melissa, Stacy's 9-yr-old sister. Angie and Stacy's problem: who can watch their kids when they're working? Their solution: Larry, a KVGS-TV newscaster, and Burt, his cameraman, their neighbors who babysit when they can, to impress the girls.

name: Руссо Экспрессо
summary: A grandiose journey along the Trans-Siberian Railway from Moscow to Vladivostok. 45 days of expedition, 10 cities and unforgettable impressions together with Timur Rodriguez and his co-host.

name: Lille Lørdag
summary: Comedy show with Norwegian comedy stars Harald Eia and Bård Tufte Johansen.

name: Gylne tider
summary: Host Øyvind Mund, cameraman Steinar Marthinsen and soundman Ingar Thorsen travel around and meet their childhood heroes.

name: Skandinavien i Hitlers jerngreb
summary: World War II is underway. Hitler is in the process of making the dream of a Nazi empire a reality, and now the turn has come to Scandinavia.

name: Takin Ova
summary: The Norwegian side of hip-hop. Rap has gone from being somewhat controversial and conflict-oriented to becoming the most dominant force in popular culture. Norwegian documentary series.

name: Norsk attraksjon
summary: Norwegian attraction takes you to attractions that you are guaranteed not to find in the guidebook - a journey in pleasant Norwegian madness with Linda Eide as guide and tour operator.

name: Rejsen til Slagmarken
summary: Cecilie Nielsen follows in the footsteps of Danish soldiers and tells about some of history's biggest battles.

name: Heroes of War: Poland
summary: 2014 marks the 75th anniversary of the beginning of World War II. This new series takes us back to a time when ordinary people became extraordinary heroes, freedom fighters, spies and code-breakers, often in deadly battles with Nazi forces. Set in Poland, which was home to some of the war's worst atrocities, Heroes of War uncovers tales of heroism and sacrifice from a number of unsung heroes of World War II. Featuring interviews with the few remaining eyewitnesses, access to newly released documents, re-enactment and archive footage, it reveals the true and, until now, hidden stories of heroism during wartime.

name: Norges herligste
summary: In Norges Herligste travels the Ylvis brothers around in Norway and meet colorful people who simply do something for themselves. The Ylvis brothers meet personalities across the country who see things differently, that burns for something special, with special hobbies or just simply is somewhat for themselves.

name: Berserk mot Sydpolen
summary: Expedition leader Jarle Andhøy and his crew sail Berserk to the South Pole to plant the Norwegian flag at the pole 100 years after Amundsen. But while Jarle and Samuel are on the ice, Berserk disappears with three of the crew. Now, for the first time, we get to see the unique photos from the trip. This will be a strong story, and a story that will give us important insight into what happened before Berserk disappeared in the winter of 2011.

name: Jakten på Berserk
summary: In Jakten på Berserk, Jarle Andhøy and his crew return to the Southern Ocean to try to find answers to what happened when Berserk disappeared. What made three experienced sailors sail into a predicted storm? Jarle Andhøy returns to Antarctica, where his ship Berserk and the crew of three disappeared in February 2011. Jarle and Samuel Massie were on the mainland when the boat unexpectedly left its safe haven, then sailed straight into a predicted storm.

name: Twist the Throttle
summary: Documentary series on the history, current production, and latest models from eight of the most famous motorcycle brands in the world.

name: Das Reich - Une division SS en France
summary:
6 June 1944, D-Day. As the Allies storm the beaches of Normandy, Hitler orders the return of the "Das Reich", the infamous Panzer elite division best known for its mass murders in the Ukraine and in Belarus, based at that time in southwest of France. Its mission: to push the Allies back into the Atlantic and turn the tide of the conflict in favor of the Germans.

The SS division, with 15,000 men and more than 200 tanks, faces relentless attacks from the Resistance as it moves north through France. Along the way, it conducts vicious reprisals and massacres of civilians (Oradour-sur-Glane, Tulle). A route paved with blood. Nothing seems to stop their progression. The division would reproduce the massacres they carried out in Belarus, using the same modus operandi (mass hangings, extermination of entire villages).

Using full HD recolorized footage, the film retraces the last year of Hitler's death squad, their last missions, their last combats and their crimes against humanity. We will follow the everyday lives of these SS officers, their recruitment and training on the Eastern Front, and try to understand who exactly were these men who perpetrated the massacres.

name: Berserk mot Nordpolen
summary: This is the documentary from the adventurous expedition as far north as possible in the Arctic Ocean with the small sailing boat "Berserk". Against all odds, Jarle Andhøy, Alex Rosen, and the king of the animals - David Mercy sailed in the wake of the Viking chieftain OTTAR and furthest north to the arctic polar edge. In a mixture of Viking and robber style, the ramshackle beach-chopping is done in Norwegian history, on Shetland and Norway, but the journey comes to an abrupt end when the Berserk expedition is thrown out of its own land on Svalbard.

name: Berserk gjennom Nordvestpassasjen
summary: Jarle Andhøy, known from his many Berserk expeditions, gathers here a group of "dented" sons of Norway, to honor his polar heroes. The crew has minimal sailing experience where they muster in Puerto Rico. Berserk is set up by a group that would rather party than work, but slowly but surely the ship is finally seaworthy. The gang sets off on a voyage that surpasses previous expeditions in the North. In a bloodless Viking raid, our modern heroes are pursued by Canadian Coast Guard ships, defense and police in this incredible voyage...

name: Berserk I Pionerenes Farvann
summary: Humorist Anne-Kat. Hærland and rock legend Petter Baarli make up the novice part of the crew on Jarle Andhøy's new Berserk expedition. The feelings are smeared in thick layers when they sail in the waters of the old whaling pioneers.

name: Out of the Blue
summary: The series features an angel-in-training named Random who comes to Chicago to help Aunt Marion deal with her five nieces and nephews she got stuck with after their parents died in a plane crash.

name: Two Minutes Silence - Remembrance Day
summary: Two minutes silence for Remembrance Day.

name: Norther Irish... Shorts
summary: Families and friends share stories and personal films of treasured memories.

name: Drenagh Estate: Deep Roots
summary: Series following Conolly McCausland as he restores 70 acres of gardens and builds a café on his family's Drenagh estate. Conolly reveals their tragic recent history as he tries to secure the future for his family.

name: FIFA Uncovered
summary: From power struggles to global politics, an exploration of FIFA reveals the organization's checkered history — and what it takes to host a World Cup.

name: Imago
summary: In the kingdom of Hilya, where mechanical beetles and jet flying carpets meet fantastic beings, lives a young boy named Zayn. He has always dreamt of owning an Imago. His wish will be granted the day he wakes up Azrokh, an almighty Imago, guardian of a magic lamp. However, he's quick to find out that with great powers, also come great responsibilities. Zayn and his friends, Awa, Zora and Kemi, who also have their own Imagos, will be propelled into an adventure that is perilous: the quest for the Primagos, six legendary Imagos, the only hopes of defeating Agoji, the queen of darkness, the greatest enemy of their kingdom that they accidentally released themselves…

name: Kamen Rider: Black Sun
summary:
The year is 2022. Half a century has passed since the government declared the coexistence of humans and Kaijin. In times of chaos, a girl named Aoi Izumi, a young human rights activist who appeals for the abolition of discrimination, meets a man. Kotaro Minami, the candidate for the next Creation King and a byproduct of the "Black Sun"'s existence.

The truth about Creation King and the Kaijin hidden within 50 years of history, and another imprisoned Creation King candidate, Shadowmoon, AKA Nobuhiko Akizuki. His encounter and reunion with Kotaro will eventually break the status quo within society.

name: Watch Dogs
summary: A "fly on the wall", partially unscripted comedy looks at incompetent, dysfunctional night-time security guards as they cause more harm than good, dealing with prostitutes, turf wars with private school boys and everything in between.

name: Last: Jøder
summary: On 26 November 1942, 529 Jewish men, women and children are sent by ship from Oslo. What happened to the Jews here, in our streets? Time witnesses tell.

name: Berserk: Veien Til Valhall
summary: The berserk expedition began in 2002 when Jarle Andhøy, Alex Rosen, The Tamil Sami and the man who is crowned King of the Animals set the world record for furthest north in a sailboat. The further aim was to sail in the wake of the Viking chieftain Ottar to the Garda Kingdom in order to establish ties of friendship with the fraternal people in the East after the fall of the Soviet Empire. But the expedition was kicked out of Spitsbergen by the Governor of Svalbard and therefore had to cancel the friendship voyage to Russia. After 3 trials and a verdict in 2004, Berserk completed the journey through Russia, but was tried to be stopped by the Police, Coast Guard, and the Russian Northern Fleet, because the King of the Animals has illegally communicated with a polar bear. Berserk, The Road to Valhall deals with the journey of the adventure voyage in Norwegian history from the Sami in northern Norway, to Russia's backyard, through the aura of the Soviet era and ends in Snorri Sturlasson's story about the Viking king Odin in his guildhalls in Valhall.

name: Let's Go Fighting
summary:
Revenge and love, which will be the first?
The mini-drama tells the story of Mu Li, the youngest daughter of the president of the Mu Group, who was recovering abroad because she was weak and sick since childhood. Later, because her sister Mu Liu accidentally got into a car accident and was in a coma, her identity was changed. Together with their fiance Mo Chen, they investigated the cause of their parents' death and the cause of their sister's car accident.
Mo Chen, the vice president of the Mo family pretending to be disabled, was injured and injured his legs fifteen years ago when he was being chased abroad. After he was secretly cured, he pretended to have problems with his legs. At first, he was fascinated by Mu Li's love words, but soon realized that she was not Mu Liu and wondered if she had other goals?
Based on the novel "Bai Yueguang from the richest family is very fierce and super daring."

name: The Secret Genius of Modern Life
summary: Hannah Fry uncovers the secrets behind the miraculous technologies of the modern world, revealing the mind-blowing stories behind their invention.

name: Return to Uist
summary: A couple and their young son move from their inner-city home in London to a wild croft in the Outer Hebrides - but with limited funds, can their dream life become a reality?

name: Potter
summary: The time has come for Redvers Potter to relinquish his role as head of the family confectionery firm, Pottermints - his company has been taken over and he is now going into enforced retirement. His wife, Aileen, is not too happy about having her husband under her feet either, but Potter is determined to make the most of his retirement. He decides he will give people the benefit of his managerial experience - even if they don't want it.

name: The Mightiest
summary: The six-episode, one-hour docu-series follows veteran adventure hosts Aliya Jasmine and Teddy Wilson as they take to the field to witness the mightiest of machines take on new missions. From re-engineered Chinook helitankers fighting wildfires 24/7 in Southern California, to a train that helps sustain life and connect communities, the series reveals the innovation and science that enable these machines to conquer nearly impossible challenges.

name: After the Storm
summary: After the Storm follows the events firsthand with the people who fought through this historic flood – from the first signs of trouble brewing over the ocean through the days of impact, with experts explaining the forces behind the disaster. In the aftermath engineers and towns race to rebuild vital infrastructure and roads connecting the coast to the rest of the country. Even when the trucks and trains are rolling again, the ongoing question is about the future: how to build back better in the face of more unpredictable weather – and more unforgiving storms to come.

name: Working Stiffs
summary: Ernie & Mike O'Rourke are two brothers who work as janitors, attempting to work their way up in a Chicago office building owned by their uncle.

previousepisode.name: My Boys Are Having a Baby

name: Struck by Lightning
summary: Ted Stein, a science teacher, inherits a spooky old New England inn inhabited by its hulking, good-naturedly homicidal caretaker Frank. It turns out that Ted is the descendant of the original Dr. Frankenstein and Frank is the Monster who needs a special serum every 50 years to stay alive, and he wants Ted to recreate it for him.

name: Paris
summary: Woody Paris, police Captain and loving husband, leads his team of detectives through the black and white and gray that constitutes the world of law and order. James Earl Jones stars as Woodrow (Woody) Paris, a captain of detectives on a metropolitan police force, who also moonlights as a professor of criminology at a local university, in "Paris," new hour-long series premiering Saturday, Sept. 29 (9:00-10.00 p m ) on the CBS Television Network. In addition, Woody is a very happily married man of long standing, and playing his wife is Lee Chamberlin. Also starring are Hank Garrett, Cecilia Hart, Jake Mitchell, Frank Ramirez, and Michael Warren. Garrett is seen as Deputy Chief of Police Jerome Bench, Paris' boss and close friend, Cecilia Hart, and Mitchell, Ramirez, and Warren appear as members of a special Metro squad under Paris' direct supervision.

name: Freebie and the Bean
summary: Two cops who turn every bust into a blast! They're the fastest-driving, hardest-hitting crimebusters ever to make you bust a gut with laughter. Freebie, a freewheeling bachelor who's strictly off the wall. The Bean, a family man who does it by the book. Based on the hit motion picture.

name: Best in the World
summary: The CBBC show that invites viewers to play along with Guinness World Records titles.

name: Out of Court
summary: The new drama features two different series of the Blinding elephant and The last Straw that take place in different times but are still interconnected. These two stories add to the suspense of the series and as little clues are added in the final truth is revealed at the show's end.

name: Wow That's Amazing
summary: Incredible experiments and mind-bending puzzles to impress your friends!

name: New Love Playlist
summary: The drama depicts the college life and romance of Corona students through entangled love line between Min-joo, Do-yoon, Tae-yong, and Yoo-jin, the four members of Seo-yeon University's Micom and the 21st class.

name: El CaroLate
summary: A beat? And in audio? Fortunately, Carolina Iglesias presents it accompanied by two comedic titans like Laura Márquez and Charlie Pee. Perhaps it is noticed that we are writing the description of the podcast, but it is that there will be stellar guests, a very devoted audience, that you will have a new episode every week... that has any late, but us? Listen for free, only on Spotify.

previousepisode.name: ¡Final de temporada! Ladilla Rusa, verano y más verano

name: Tage, die es nicht gab
summary: Miriam, Doris, Inès and Christiane have been friends since school, but now they have to face the secrets of the past. In the case of the successful public prosecutor and mother of three, Miriam, the secrets put her marriage to Joachim in jeopardy. Doris successfully manages a trucking company, but is overshadowed by her all-ruling mother. Inès was in Paris for many years and is now returning to Zollberg. She also hopes that her son will finally get off drugs. Writer Christiane suffers a terrible loss, but she can count on her friends. In small steps she finds her way back to life, but can she also get closer to her husband? In all of this, the investigations of Commissioner Elfriede Grünberger burst. Together with her colleague Leodolter, she tries to solve a murder that had long been thought to be a suicide. The trust and solidarity of the four friends is put to the test.

name: Yinhe Zhi Xin
summary: Cosmic wanderer Li Yuesu accidentally found the immigration spacecraft "Shangjia" which had gone missing several years ago and witnessed a horrifying supernatural phenomenon... People gradually realized the impending catastrophe. At long last, the different forces in the planet Cornil had to work together to fight against the powerful enemy. However, the alien race was far stronger than they expected. Right before they met their demise, the people of Cornil had to send Li Yuesu to the heart of the Milky Way to seek help from the powerful human civilization.

name: Женщина с котом и детективом
summary: Yulia Loginova is a dentist and aspiring detective writer. She recently published her first novel, which received a lot of positive feedback from readers. Fans are waiting for a new book, but there is a nuance. Loginova's boyfriend, Investigative Committee investigator Denis Potapov, believes that the first book was written thanks to his stories and advice, and wants to get his share of the pie and be a co-author of the book. Because of this, Denis and Yulia quarrel, and Yulia is left without a source of inspiration for new detective stories. Soon Julia becomes an unwitting witness to the murder. She has the opportunity to directly participate in the investigation.

name: Полкан
summary: The protagonist of Polkan is a young lieutenant named Slava Kurochka. As soon as he joined the service, his partner Pavlo Safronov fell into a coma. And then the fun began: the operative's soul moved into a dog! And the only one who can hear Safronov in the dog's body is his young and inexperienced partner Kurochka. At the same time, the police will be catching criminals and looking for a way to return Safronov back to a human body. Along the way, they will constantly find themselves in funny situations.

name: Here's Boomer
summary: The adventures of Boomer, a stray dog that travels around helping people who are in trouble.

name: Goodtime Girls
summary: Experiences of Camille, Betty, Edith and Loretta, four working girls sharing a Washington D.C. apartment and enduring the hardships of World War II - including rationing and the man shortage.

name: Spine Chillers
summary: Not for the nervous! Classic tales of fear and imagination.

name: Secrets of Midland Heights
summary: In Midland Heights there are only two kinds of people - the powerful Millingtons and everyone else. Rich and poor. Good and bad. Three generations locked in conflict. Each fighting for the right to live and love their own way.

name: Big Cook Little Cook
summary: Cooking, songs, silliness and fun with Jen and Small.

name: Dog Squad
summary: Join the superskilled, big-hearted team of assistance dogs Kika, Diesel, Meagaidh, Sylvie and Tinks, as they use their superpowers to complete important missions for their owners.

name: Lost Cities of the Bible
summary: A land of myth and legend, ancient Iraq is the cradle of human civilization dating back to the Old Testament; and now, pioneering archaeologists gain rare access to investigate sacred sites and reveal the truth behind forgotten Biblical cities.

name: PRAXX
summary: The fun gives way to terror when six young college students drown in suspicious circumstances.

name: Sausage Party: Foodtopia
summary: After killing off all of humanity, Food attempts to create their own utopia.

name: VisionQuest
summary: After the events of WandaVision, White Vision struggles to connect with the memories given to him as he lacks the emotions or feelings associated with them.

name: Женский клуб
summary: In this talk show, five witty hosts will share personal stories to discuss how they navigated various life challenges. From building healthy relationships and dealing with abuse to navigating motherhood without emotional crises and managing family finances, the show covers everything that matters to women.

name: When the World Watched
summary: Preview shows for the 2022 FIFA World Cup in the lead up to the event.

name: The Footballer, His Wife and the Car Crash
summary: Two-part documentary revealing the truth about the life of footballer Jlloyd Samuel, and how his Premier League footballing dream spiraled into a nightmare.

name: Makeaway Takeaway
summary: Get stuck into the funniest art show around. Whether it's creative solutions for smelly feet or ideas on puppet building, Bec Hill brings her top tips for crafty first aid.

name: Italia 90: When Football Changed Forever
summary: The story of the World Cup that determined the future of English football - a watershed tournament for the team, fans, and the nation back home.

name: Made in the 80s: The Decade That Shaped Our World
summary: The extraordinary story of how a Britain in turmoil changed the world by stealth through its politics, culture and technology.

name: It's Fine, I'm Fine
summary: A suburban psychologist and her patients explore love, loss, obsession, anxiety, and an uncertain future, while grappling with how to persist and find magic in the world

name: Trois femmes flics
summary: Three friends, accomplices and roommates make their debut in the police department in different positions, finding themselves investigating sometimes risky cases.

name: Ancient Apocalypse
summary: What if everything we know about prehistoric humans is wrong? Journalist Graham Hancock visits archaeological sites around the world to uncover whether a civilization far more advanced than we ever believed possible existed thousands of years ago.

name: Crystal Lake
summary: Prequel series to Friday the 13th, follows a doomed small town where camp counselors come to die.

name: UNTOLD
summary: UNTOLD pushes boundaries with unparalleled access, fearless storytelling, and raw honesty — featuring a fresh slate of compelling documentaries that reveal what's really happening behind closed doors.

name: The Prank Panel
summary:
The Prank Panel lets everyday people pitch pranks targeting family members, friends and co-workers to a panel of the world's greatest pranksters.  

Johnny Knoxville, Eric Andre and Gabourey Sidibe form the all-star panel of "pranxperts," taking viewers behind the scenes as they help to plot and plan elaborate and diabolical schemes.  The Panelists serve as mentors and saboteurs, with celebrity guests sometimes joining the fun.

name: Goles en contra
summary: This series explores how Colombia's social context in the '80s and '90s impacted soccer and had a role in the murder of player Andrés Escobar.

name: O Rei da TV
summary: 1989. With a clean bill of health, Silvio Santos is riding the wave of success SBT has built as a TV channel. Silvio is running for president of Brazil, and while polls show high favorability for him among the people, his opponents seek to remove him from the race, leading him to fight back where he feels most at ease: in front of the camera. By the early 90s, Silvio is determined to overthrow Globo as the most watched TV channel, but his efforts come at a high cost and he is forced to put Gugu on Sunday afternoons — the coveted time slot he dominated for 20 years. As years pass during the ratings battle between Globo and SBT, the programming becomes more scandalous, with SBT inching closer to the top. A media frenzy grips the country with the kidnapping of Silvio's daughter Patricia, a situation that leads to Silvio himself being threatened at gunpoint. Years later, a scandal at the PanAmericano bank threatens to upend Silvio's empire.

name: Prova Prova Sa Sa
summary: 4 episodes, 4 comedians, 1 conductor, a studio audience and improvisation are the winning elements of this new comedy show to be laughed at. Maccio Capatonda, Maria Di Biase, Edoardo Ferrario and Aurora Leone, under the guidance of Frank Matano, compete in this unmissable first season of Prova Prova Sa Sa, the show where everything is improvised.

name: Comédie ! The Story
summary: An anthology of the best sketches of "Comedy!" made as part of its various productions such as "La Grosse Emission" or "52 minutes pour rire": the Robins des Bois, Kad and Olivier, Patrick Bosso, Dominique Farrugia, Jonathan Lambert, Axelle Laffont and many others will be there. part.

name: I Will Be Your Bloom
summary: Asuka had once realized her goal to become a teacher, but after a gutting failure, she gives up her dream profession and becomes extremely withdrawn. After a series of events, she finds herself becoming a live-in housemother for a dorm... where the boy band septet 8LOOM live together! At the dorm, she is reunited with her former student Dan—as a teacher, Asuka used to encourage him to go for his dreams. Inspired by Dan's leadership in the band and his passion for making his dream come true, Asuka, too, regains the passion she had in her teaching days and comes to terms with her own failure.

name: Helsinki-syndrooma
summary: Entrepreneur Elias Karo takes four journalists hostage in order to reveal that 30 years ago, a bank manager and a district court judge took his family's possessions with the government's blessing and caused a still ongoing family tragedy.

name: Switch
summary: In Switch, five players begin the game by taking positions behind large numbers from 1 to 5. After a trivia question is asked, players with correct answers move towards the number 1 spot, and players with incorrect answers move towards the number 5 spot. The goal of the game is to finish the third round of questions in the number 1 position, thus winning the game and earning the right to play the bonus round for $10,000.

previousepisode.name: Come With Me On A Journey

name: Blanca
summary: After losing her sight at the age of twelve, Blanca is one step away from fulfilling her lifelong dream: working in the police force. But once she arrives at the police station for an internship, she comes up against everyone's distrust. Thanks to the skills that she has developed over the years, however, and the help of her dog Linnaeus, she reveals Blanca as a detective with a different and effective "look". Based on the novels by Patrizia Rinaldi, "Blanca" is the first television series in the world shot in holophony, a special sound recording technique that allows you to be in the protagonist's place: hear how she hears and reconstructs the world.

name: Skyggespill
summary: Norwegian documentary series about Henry Rinnan.

name: Tony Robinson's Museum of Us
summary: Sir Tony Robinson and an expert design team help groups of residents explore their own street's history, as they unearth surprising stories and hidden treasures.

name: Warplane Workshop
summary: From the iconic Spitfire to the light plane that became America's secret weapon in Vietnam, this series follows the struggle to save military relics from the scrapheap.

name: Magda's Big National Health Check
summary: Magda Szubanski embarks on an immersive and personal journey to discover what health looks like in Australia today, revealing major health challenges facing our society and how we can work together to improve our chances of a healthy life.

name: The Day of the Jackal
summary: The Day of the Jackal follows an unrivaled and highly elusive lone assassin, the Jackal, who makes his living carrying out hits for the highest fee. But following his latest kill, he meets his match in a tenacious British intelligence officer who starts to track down the Jackal in a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase across Europe, leaving destruction in its wake.

name: Elpis: Kibou, Aruiwa Wazawai
summary: Defined as the spirit of hope in Greek mythology, Elpis centers around Asakawa Ena, an ace announcer who fell from her position due to a scandal; Kishimoto Takuro, a young director of a variety show; and Saito Seiichi, an ace reporter, as they work together to pursue the truth behind a serial murder case which the death penalty has been set.

name: Reibai Tantei Jozuka Hisui
summary: Jozuka Hisui has a special ability that allows her to identify people who committed murder and she can hear spirits. She can't tell the police, because they would not believe her. Her special ability also couldn't be used as legal evidence. She leads a lonely life due to her special ability. Jozuka Hisui meets mystery writer Kogetsu Shiro, who helps the police to solve cases. Jozuka Hisui and Kogetsu Shiro work together to solve cases.

name: Shinai naru Boku e Satsui wo Komete
summary: To most people, Eiji Urashima seems like a pretty typical university student. He goes to class, studies when he should, and has fun hanging out with his friends. But what most people don't know is that Eiji is the son of a serial killer. Known for murdering female university students in horrendous ways, Eiji's father has built quite a reputation for himself. As much as Eiji abhors what his father does, there's nothing he can do to stop him. As if being the son of a serial killer wasn't bad enough, Eiji often suffers from memory blackouts, and they seem to be getting worse. Beginning to fear he may be sharing his life with an alternate personality, Eiji's fears only escalate when a new murder takes place, a murder which exactly matches the style of his sadistic father.

name: Subete Wasurete Shimau kara
summary: M, a mystery writer, has a girlfriend of five years named F, who disappeared on Halloween night. When a woman comes and claims to be her sister, M begins the search for his girlfriend. Along the way, the people he meets describe a woman very unlike the F he knew.

name: Snack on This!
summary: Snack on This! takes viewers behind the scenes for a fascinating look at how their favorite foods are made. Hosted by Kalen Allen, this immersive series goes inside factories producing American's favorite treats, revealing origin stories and amazing manufacturing feats about brands from Jelly Bellies to Coca Cola.

name: Milkshake! Story Den
summary: Join the Milkshake! presenters in the Story Den, as they read children's books.

name: Parking Hell
summary: Documentary following the daily battles across Britain for parking spaces, looking at the struggles faced by motorists, councils and private parking companies.

name: The World According to Grandpa
summary: Grandpa answers his curious grandchildren's questions with fantastic stories.

previousepisode.name: Why Do Monkeys Live in Trees?

name: The Affair
summary: When Hala and Omar are interrogated for a murder investigation, they're prompted to recall how their relationship began as an affair.

name: Room 207
summary: Upon starting his post as a hotel receptionist, Gamal hears the rumors about the mysterious Room 207 and finds himself obsessed with discovering the truth.

name: Al Maktab
summary: In a postal service company in Riyadh, a group of employees go about their daily work while dealing with their clumsy, but kind-hearted boss.

name: Cooking with the Gills
summary: Farmer JB Gill and his family reach out to talented young cooks from all over the UK.

name: Expedition: Black Sea Wrecks
summary: A journey to the depths of the Black Sea yields the greatest series of ancient shipwrecks ever discovered. In 2015, an international team of scientists began a 3 year exploration of the Black Sea in search of evidence of the ancient empires that sailed their ships into unknown waters in pursuit of trade, treasure and conquest. This documentary captures a series of astonishing discoveries made; a treasure trove of shipwrecks uniquely preserved that date back two and a half thousand years to the Greek and Roman empires, culminating in maritime archaeology's greatest ever wreck. A fully intact Roman wreck, perfectly preserved in the anoxic waters of the Black Sea.

name: The Gentlemen
summary: When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to an enormous weed empire — and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.

name: The Answers
summary: Based on Catherine Lacey's novel of the same name, The Answers is set in the near future, where a heartbroken young woman joins an enigmatic experiment that promises to hack love, but after moving into an idyllic, secluded location with her fellow female participants, she and the other women start questioning what's really happening in the experiment, and why they've all been tasked with dating the same mysterious man.

name: Bosé
summary: A 6-episode biopic of Spanish singer-songwriter Miguel Bosé. Son of two icons of Spain under repressive dictator Francisco Franco: the macho Luis Miguel Dominguín, one of Spain's most famous bullfighters, and Lucía Bosé, star of Michelangelo Antonioni and Juan Antonio Bardem, few people have known so many people as Miguel Bosé.

name: Draw the Line
summary: Fang Yuan, the chief judge of the Xingcheng District People's Court, and Song Yufei, the deputy chief judge of the Criminal Division of the Rongzhou Intermediate People's Court, are the apprentices of Zhang Weimin, the vice president of the Xingcheng District People's Court. The three teachers and apprentices dedicated their youth and passion to China's judicial career.

name: Lighter and Princess
summary: Li Wei is a cool and calculating computer programming ace who gained special admission to college. To others, he can sometimes seem aloof and distant, but this is mainly down to his worldview: He sees life as one great big computer program, and only feels comfortable when he is in control of what is going on. He knows nothing of love – considering it to be an emotion that may be beyond his understanding.

name: Khakee: The Bihar Chapter
summary: As a righteous cop pursues a merciless criminal in Bihar, he finds himself navigating a deadly chase and a moral battle mired in corruption.
